description.zh: 设置从返回结果的第几页开始显示查询结果。默认值为1，表示从第1页开始显示。
description.en: The page number. Default value: 1. Pages start from page 1.

description.zh: 要查询的公网IP资产所在地域ID。
description.en: The region ID of the asset.

description.zh:
要查询的公网IP资产的DDoS防护状态，取值：

- **defense**：清洗中，即查询正在进行流量清洗的公网IP资产。
- **blackhole**：黑洞中，即查询处于黑洞状态的公网IP资产。
description.en:
The DDoS mitigation status of the asset. Valid values:

*   **defense**: queries assets for which traffic scrubbing is performed.
*   **blackhole**: queries assets for which blackhole filtering is triggered.

description.zh: 要查询的公网IP资产所属的Custom实例ID。
description.en: The ID of the RDS Custom instance to which the asset to query is added.

description.zh: 要查询的公网IP资产的IP地址。
description.en: The IP address of the asset to query.

description.zh: 要查询的公网IP资产所属的Custom实例名称。
description.en: The name of the RDS Custom instance to which the asset to query is added.

description.zh: 要查询的公网IP资产的实例类型，固定值**ecs**。
description.en: The type of the asset that is assigned a public IP address. Set the value to **ecs**.

description.zh: 设置分页查询时每一页的实例数。
description.en: The number of instances on each page.
The ID of the region in which the RDS Custom instance resides.
The type of the resource. Set the value to **ecs**.

title.zh: 查询RDS Custom实例的DDos防护信息及所属原生防护实例的详情

descriptions.zh:
### 适用引擎
RDS SQL Server

### 相关功能文档
[RDS Custom简介](~~2864363~~)

> 一个[DDoS原生防护](~~63643~~)实例包含一个或者多个公网IP资产的场景下，您可以调用本接口查询当前阿里云账号下RDS Custom for SQL Server实例的DDos防护信息及所属原生防护实例的详情，例如DDoS基础防护阈值、流量清洗阈值、公网IP资产的DDoS防护状态、实例ID、实例的防护状态等。
descriptions.en:
### [](#)Supported database engine

SQL Server

### [](#)References

[Introduction to ApsaraDB RDS Custom](~~2864363~~)

>  If one or more assets of the current Alibaba Cloud account are added to an [Anti-DDoS Origin instance](~~63643~~), you can call the DescribeRCInstanceIpAddress operation to query the DDoS mitigation information and the details of the Anti-DDoS Origin instance. The information and the details include the basic protection threshold and traffic scrubbing threshold for the assets, DDoS mitigation status of the assets, ID of the instance, and the mitigation status of the instance.

example.unifiedCli: aliyun rds describe-rc-instance-ip-address --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --instance-type ecs --ddos-status defense --instance-id rc-y6dn4pyuub1r89000000 --instance-ip 39.105.XXX.XXX --current-page 1 --page-size 10 --resource-type ecs --ddos-region-id cn-beijing --instance-name rc-y6dn4pyuub1r89000000 --region cn-hangzhou
example.legacyCli: aliyun rds DescribeRCInstanceIpAddress --region cn-hangzhou --InstanceName 'rc-y6dn4pyuub1r89000000' --DdosRegionId 'cn-beijing' --PageSize 10 --InstanceId 'rc-y6dn4pyuub1r89000000' --CurrentPage 1 --DdosStatus defense --InstanceIp '39.105.XXX.XXX' --ResourceType ecs --RegionId 'cn-hangzhou' --InstanceType ecs
